name: XLRON
description: X-elerated Learning and Resource Allocation for Optical Networks

paragraphs: ## 🎉 XLRON v1.0.0 is here! 🎉 The new major release of XLRON is now out. See the full release notes: GitHub release v1.0.0.
Live render of the per-link spectrum allocations made by a Graph Transformer agent trained with RL on DeepRMSA-NSFNET. Click for the full-resolution video.
features: Fast. 222–1,494× faster end-to-end RL training than DeepRMSA / Optical-RL-Gym; up to 6 × 10⁶ steps/s on a single A100. (benchmarks)
Most comprehensive feature set of any open-source optical-network simulation library. (feature comparison)

Accurate physical layer — closed-form ISRS GN model with distributed Raman amplification, Nyquist subchannels, and EGN correction, validated to within 0.5 dB against the Gerard et al. 2025 record-throughput C+L-band…

First fully differentiable optical-network simulator. Gradients flow end-to-end through the physical layer and resource-allocation logic, enabling gradient-based pump power optimisation and direct RSA optimisation.…
All 119 real-world topologies from TopologyBench bundled out of the box, including very large ones like USA100 (100 nodes) and TataInd (143 nodes). (topologies)
